notes: The November 2008 Bryant–Denny Stadium. Includes the playing field, lower bowl, east and west upper decks and canopies, 2006 north upper stand, brick entrance and circulation, and the lower south end. Later additions and the detached Denny Chimes tower are outside scope. The modern outer controls include the later south upper stand. Use the mapped field and surviving alignments to anchor the historical reconstruction.
